# Top Management Brief: Synthetic pump fire, 2024

**Audience:** Corporate leadership (T5)

**Incident:** Synthetic pump fire · 2024-03-20

## Bottom line

- Seals were bought locally without a specification for two years, and nothing stopped it. [FND-0003]

## Executive summary

A pump was restarted after a seal change without a leak test [FND-0001]. Its seals had been bought locally without a specification since March 2022 [FND-0003].

HFACS sorts causes into four levels: unsafe acts (L1), preconditions (L2), supervision (L3) and organisational influences (L4).

## Transferability

| Learning | Transferability | Reason | Cites |
|---|---|---|---|
| Spares bought without a specification | Likely at similar sites | Any site that buys spares locally | FND-0003 |

## Policies and standards implicated

### Spares and sourcing

Purchase records show local buying with no specification check [FND-0003; EVD-0003].

## Decisions for top management

### Critical spares

**Decision:** Set one enterprise rule for critical-spares specifications [FND-0003]
- Options: Mandatory standard; Guidance with audit
- Trade-offs: Cost and lead time against consistent parts.

**Indicator:** Sites with verified spares specifications [FND-0003]
- Measure: % of sites whose critical-spares orders all cite a specification

## Assurance

**Q: How will we know every site applies the spares rule?** [FND-0003]
- Why it matters: Local buying without a specification ran for two years before this event.
- Good evidence looks like: Sampled audits from the auditor assurance pack
- Put to: Head of internal audit
